requirements.requirement: The system must define a Pydantic model named SponsorCredibility with fields sponsor_type, funding_source, institution_name, collaborators, reputation_score, and transparency_flag.
The system must include raw ClinicalTrials.gov fields lead_sponsor, collaborators, and funding_source in the schema for mapping purposes.
The system must enforce sponsor_type as an enum with allowed values: university, hospital, pharma, and unknown.
The system must enforce funding_source as an enum with allowed values: public, industry, other, and undisclosed.
The system must define collaborators as a list of strings representing collaborating institutions.
The system must define institution_name as a non-empty string when lead_sponsor data is present.
The system must allow reputation_score to be nullable to support cases where scoring is not yet computed.
The system must define transparency_flag as a boolean indicating whether funding_source is disclosed.
The system must correctly map lead_sponsor.name from ClinicalTrials.gov data into institution_name.
The system must map collaborator entries from ClinicalTrials.gov into the collaborators list without data loss.
The system must default sponsor_type to unknown when lead_sponsor data is missing or null.
The system must default funding_source to undisclosed when funding_source data is missing or null.
The system must raise a validation error if collaborators is provided but is not a list type.
The system must raise a validation error if sponsor_type or funding_source contains a value outside the allowed enums.
